Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenFiredHeaterCombustionBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenFiredHeaterCombustionBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenFiredHeaterCombustionBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable complete-combustion receipt downstream of a qualified fired-heater utility balance.

The caller supplies a dry, ash-free CHSON elemental fuel basis, dry-air oxygen mole fraction, and excess-oxygen fraction. The receipt applies element conservation only; it does not predict incomplete combustion, dissociation, NOx, CO, unburned hydrocarbons, heat transfer, or stack temperature.

Version:
1.0
Author:
esolbr1

    • calculate

      public static RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenFiredHeaterCombustionBalance calculate(RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenFiredHeaterUtilityBalance utilityBalance, double carbonMassFraction, double hydrogenMassFraction, double sulfurMassFraction, double oxygenMassFraction, double nitrogenMassFraction, double dryAirOxygenMoleFraction, double excessOxygenFraction)
      Calculate a complete-combustion and flue-gas element balance.
      Parameters:
      utilityBalance - qualified fired-heater utility receipt
      carbonMassFraction - dry, ash-free fuel carbon mass fraction
      hydrogenMassFraction - dry, ash-free fuel hydrogen mass fraction
      sulfurMassFraction - dry, ash-free fuel sulfur mass fraction
      oxygenMassFraction - dry, ash-free fuel oxygen mass fraction
      nitrogenMassFraction - dry, ash-free fuel nitrogen mass fraction
      dryAirOxygenMoleFraction - caller-supplied dry-air oxygen mole fraction in (0, 1)
      excessOxygenFraction - oxygen supplied above stoichiometric demand divided by demand
      Returns:
      immutable combustion receipt
